title: joseau11's co-op extras (off by default in 0.9.170): aiming for both players, auto-resume, rumble
intro: Needs two controllers and two people (or two hands), DPC 0.9.170. Co-op off, playing the Arisen, open ground. Tough goblins that cannot die are spawned. Press End (keyboard) when ready.

steps.text: Get ready: both controllers in hand. Press End to start.
PLAYER 1: press something on your controller. PLAYER 2: hold L3 + R3 until 'player 2 joined'. (L3 + R3 also moves this guide on; keep holding.)
Spawning three goblins that cannot die in front of you.
AIM, PLAYER 2: tap R3 to keep a target (a marker in your colour?), flick the right stick left / right to change target, tap R3 again to free it.
AIM, PLAYER 1: press R3 to keep the enemy nearest the screen centre (your colour marker). Then PLAYER 2: hold R3 to take player 1's target.
RUMBLE: player 2 attacks, uses a skill, and lets a goblin hit the pawn. Does player 2's controller rumble (and only theirs)?
AUTO-RESUME: open the map and fast travel / or rest at an inn or camp (anything with a load screen). After the load, does co-op start again by itself? Press End when back in the world.
Removing the goblins, co-op off, everything back off.
Done. Tell Claude which parts worked: markers, R3 keep / flick / take, player 1's R3, rumble, auto-resume.

probes.x:
local o = {}
local R = _G.DPC_dbg and _G.DPC_dbg.R
if R then
  pcall(function() local st = R.api_table.state(); o[#o+1] = "coop=" .. tostring(st.coop.active) .. " two=" .. tostring(st.coop.two_pads) end)
  pcall(function() o[#o+1] = "p2pin=" .. tostring(R.ta.pin ~= nil) .. " p1tgt=" .. tostring(R.ta.p1 ~= nil) end)
  pcall(function() o[#o+1] = "resume_want=" .. tostring(R.cr.want) end)
  pcall(function() o[#o+1] = string.format("rumble=%s err=%s", tostring(os.clock() < (R.rb.until_t or 0)), tostring(R.rb.err)) end)
  pcall(function() o[#o+1] = "tp_err=" .. tostring(R.tp.err) end)
end
return table.concat(o, " ")
